mapper.select: select id, question_revision_id, context_hash, rubric_data, generator_model, generator_prompt_version from cm_question_ai_rubric where question_revision_id=#{questionRevisionId}
mapper.insert: insert into cm_question_ai_rubric(id, question_revision_id, context_hash, rubric_data, generator_model, generator_prompt_version) values(#{id}, #{revisionId}, #{contextHash}, #{rubric}::jsonb, #{model}, #{promptVersion}) on conflict(question_revision_id) do nothing

insert into cm_ai_grading_task(id, task_key, task_type, question_revision_id, session_question_id, attempt_id, payload) values(#{id}, #{taskKey}, #{taskType}, #{revisionId}, #{sessionQuestionId}, #{attemptId}, #{payload}::jsonb) on conflict(task_key) do nothing
mapper.select: with candidate as ( select id from cm_ai_grading_task where status='pending' and next_retry_time <= now() order by create_time for update skip locked limit 1 ) update cm_ai_grading_task t set status='processing', claimed_time=now(), update_time=now() from candidate where t.id=candidate.id returning t.id, t.task_key, t.task_type, t.status, t.question_revision_id, t.session_question_id, t.attempt_id, t.payload::text, t.result::text, t.error_code, t.retry_count
mapper.update: update cm_ai_grading_task set status=case when retry_count < 2 then 'pending' else 'failed' end, retry_count=case when retry_count < 2 then retry_count+1 else retry_count end, error_code='AI_GRADING_LEASE_EXPIRED', next_retry_time=case when retry_count < 2 then now() + interval '5 seconds' else next_retry_time end, claimed_time=null, completed_time=case when retry_count < 2 then completed_time else now() end, update_time=now() where status='processing' and coalesce(claimed_time, create_time) <= now() - (#{leaseSeconds} * interval '1 second')
update cm_ai_grading_task set status='succeeded', result=#{result}::jsonb, completed_time=now(), update_time=now() where id=#{id} and status='processing'

update cm_ai_grading_task set status='pending', retry_count=retry_count+1, error_code=#{errorCode}, next_retry_time=now() + interval '5 seconds', update_time=now() where id=#{id} and status='processing' and retry_count < 2
update cm_ai_grading_task set status='failed', error_code=#{errorCode}, completed_time=now(), update_time=now() where id=#{id} and status='processing'
